notes.title: Valor & Victory - New tournament open for sign-up
notes.content:
Do not miss the chance to sign-up to the new tournament “Battle at the Dourves Radar Station”. You can sign-up here.

The tournament follows Swiss Tournament rules: you can find the full list of rules here.

Join Battle at the Dourves Radar Station in 3 tournament matches across Normandy:

 Round #1 - Battle at the Douvres Radar Station - Game Turns: 6 - Victory Conditions: Attacker must control all objectives
 Round #2 - Counter Attack At Villiers Le Sec - Game Turns: 6 - Victory Conditions: Attacker must exit
 Round #3 - Payday for French Commandos - Game Turns: 7 - Victory Conditions: Attacker must control all objectives

The first round will commence on Wednesday, 17th July 2024 at 7am GMT. No further entries can be accepted after the tournament has begun. The tournament will last 3 rounds, 20 days each. Games are paired, so each matchup will be played both ways. All you need to do is sign up, then the system will pair you with opponents and create your PBEM games. You will be notified by mail of when the tournament is starting and when it will be time to play your turns.

notes.title: Steam Workshop available for Valor & Victory
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33792772/5054b6d1f1f6937c5bf275817d82c5c53977465b.jpg

We are happy to announce that Valor & Victory is now on Steam Workshop. Mods can now be downloaded directly through Steam, simply subscribe to a mod through its Steam Workshop page and the mod will be automatically installed for you for the next time you start the game.

In addition, we have a new patch live (1.02.02)! Here's what's new: 

-PBEM: now return to PBEM games screen after finishing PBEM game turn

-Added option to reverse mouse map zoom

Fixed

 Crash when moving next to Transport and Opportunity fire happens
 Crash when moving next to Stug
 Scenario Editor - Cannot remove units from transport when loading in draft version
 Scenario Editor - Units on transport now displayed when loading draft version
 AT gun can fire at infantry stack not in firing arc
 Language options available after finishing a scenario
 AI crashes in custom scenario when first squad to fire has a bazooka
 Sound sliders in options should now save correctly
 Mouse click delays sometimes seen when in zoom mode
 Cannot import scenario zip files

notes.title: Valor & Victory - New Patch (v1.02.01) - Zoom and UI scaling now available
notes.content:
We have just released a new patch (v1.02.01) for Valor & Victory, including some of the most requested features and bringing many new fixes to the game.

NEW FEATURES

 Map Zooming In and Out: the game now supports different zoom levels.
 We added UI Scaling in the options menu.
 We added music settings in the options menu.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33792772/91162a8d2d199ed2e6234f95b5415c98585b8485.gif

FIXED

 In addition to that, the patch brings many fixes to the game.
 You can exit from anywhere on the map for an exit based scenario
 Scenario Editor always loads a saved draft exit map with British flag
 Panzerschreck is spelt "Panzershreck"
 Various map LOS issues
 Fixed crash in PBEM when player has used smoke

notes.title: Valor & Victory - First patch, v1.01.00
notes.content:
We have just released the first patch for Valor & Victory, including fixes (thanks for your reports!) and improvements.

Our next updates after this will address other feedback, such as the ability to zoom in and out - sorry we couldn't get it into this first patch.


NEW
New Victory Popups
- Player now gets points
- Player can see % losses on both sides

FIXED
- Points now sent to PBEM as game progresses
- Cannot switch to English if using PC set to another language
- Cannot unload units that are loaded into a vehicle during the game
- Pressing the Esc key to unselect units in movement can cause them to be unresponsive after
- Game hangs when AI fires AT weapon from pinned unit
- Crash when AI vehicle cannot find a target to move towards
- Crash when sometimes unselecting units
- Updated French translations
- Updated Spanish translations
- Correct British Flag

notes.title: Valor & Victory is out now
notes.content:
Valor & Victory, the digital version of the classic hex and counter tabletop wargame, is out now.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/963870/Valor__Victory/

With 20 scenarios based around real events shortly after the Normandy Landings in 1944, the game challenges you to achieve different objectives: eliminate the enemy, capture objectives or exit certain units off of the map.

[previewyoutube=jv9t3TyHSnA;full][/previewyoutube]

Battle of Douvres Radar Station - 77th anniversary
The game features the Battle of Douvres Radar Station, which took place on June 17th, 1944. Today marks its 77th anniversary: the British 41 Commando, Royal Marines led the attack supported by the tanks of the 79th Armoured Division. The Radar at Douvres was the main Luftwaffe radar station in the area. It was a fortified position with five radars, minefields, bunkers and ringed by barbed wire. The scenario covers the final assault by 41 Commando with a couple of Shermans in support. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33792772/b39f45fdb44f7d07ace6fd1293bed315a8977cee.png

Manual and tutorial videos

Check out the PDF manual for a complete guide to your first steps. You can also have a look at these tutorial videos to find out how the turn phases play out and how to build your own scenarios with the built-in scenario editor.

Sign up for the "Operation Overlord" tournament
Valor & Victory launches with tournament support: if you're looking to test your skills, you can sign up here and join the Operation Overlord tournament. All you need to do is sign up, then the system will pair you with opponents and create your PBEM games. You will be notified by mail of when the tournament is starting, and when it will be time to play your turns.

The tournament will officially start on July 1sr, and it will include three rounds, each one lasting 21 days.

You will challenge your opponents in three scenarios:


 June 6th, 1944 - St. Marie Du Mont, France
 June 6th, 1944 - The Fight for Colleville, France
 June 17th, 1944 - Battle of Douvres Radar Station, France


Tabletop Wargames - Steam Exclusive Bundle
Valor & Victory launches with a Steam exclusive bundle: if you're into World War 2 board games and you already own Heroes of Normandie, you'll get a 15% discount on Valor & Victory.

Check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/21575/Tabletop_Wargames

notes.title: Valor & Victory - How to play #3
notes.content:
Valor & Victory is going to be released on June 17th. In this third tutorial video, we will be covering the powerful Scenario Editor that is included with the game. The editor allows you to create your own scenarios as well as edit existing scenarios, allowing you to extend your enjoyment of the game and share your creations with others.

	Comprehensive tools: You can change everything from what units are deployed, to defensive object placement, to the mission objectives themselves and more.
	 	Multiplayer Compatibility: Share your creations with your friends and play the Scenarios you've created together in multiplayer mode.
	 	Easy To Use: Simple point and click editing allows anyone of any skill level to create their own engaging missions. The limit is only your imagination.
